summary: Tested partner-logo upload inside the home_partners group, keeping the section on replace, crop zoom, and how logos display on the Home carousel. Found and fixed 1 critical backend bug: replacing a logo moved it to the 'other' section. All flows pass after the fix.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The lookup for the existing asset used filters={'key': f'eq.{key}'}, but sb_select() already adds 'eq.', so the query became key=eq.eq.<key> and matched nothing. Because of that, replacing without a section always reset section to 'other' and sort_order to 100. This was the user's bug 1 (a replaced logo ended up in Custom uploads). Changed to filters={'key': key}.

minor.issue: The storage object name comes from the uploaded filename and is upserted (x-upsert: true). If two different assets are uploaded with the same filename (e.g. 'logo.png'), the second overwrites the first one's image in storage, so both assets show the same picture. Replacing a file with a same-named file is also served stale because of Cache-Control max-age=31536000. Replace also leaves the old storage object orphaned (qa1.png stayed after replacing with qa2.png). Suggest object_name = f'{key}_{timestamp}{ext}' or appending a hash.

issues: Square logos (e.g. 500x500 EVOSMART, 2560x2560 evowaste) are limited by the tile height (77px) under object-contain, so they look smaller than wide logos. This is correct proportionally, but users must use zoom to make them bigger. Could consider trimming transparent padding automatically.
The Replace file input on the card has no data-testid (e.g. asset-replace-{key}).

action_items: Review the backend fix in server.py upload_asset: existing lookup now uses filters={'key': key}
Make storage object names unique per asset (key + timestamp/hash) to avoid overwriting between assets and stale CDN cache; optionally delete the old object on replace
Add data-testid to the Replace file input on asset cards
Admin.jsx is 966 lines; split ImagesPanel and FocalEditorModal into separate modules
critical_code_review_comments: sb_select filter misuse (double eq.) caused the section-loss bug. grep found no other filter value passed with a manual 'eq.' prefix.

BulkLogoUpload makes 2 calls per logo (POST then PUT for alt/meta). If the PUT fails, the logo stays in home_partners with no name or category (defaults to the partner row). It is toasted as a failure but not rolled back.
BulkLogoUpload: the per-row remove (trash) button has no data-testid.
